source: NASA/JPL OSCAR sea-surface velocity (1/3° L4), served by NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP as jplOscar
attribution: Ocean surface currents: NASA/JPL OSCAR via NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP (U.S. Government work, public domain). Paths traced through the measured mean velocity field; names and seed points are editorial.
method: mean of 8 five-day composites on a 1° grid; named paths integrated (RK2, 60 km steps) from a published seed on each current's core; warm/cold derived from the net poleward change along the trace
